name: Zoho Catalyst for Students
benefit: Up to US$250 of Catalyst cloud-platform usage at no charge during a six-month period for qualifying student applications.
eligibility: Students using Catalyst to build legitimate non-commercial educational, experimental, or personal projects.
duration: US$250 usage threshold over six months; further free usage requires case-by-case Catalyst Support review and approval, not guaranteed automatic renewal.
restrictions: No subscription or credit card required for the student program. Apps temporarily stop at the US$250 threshold rather than automatically charging. Commercial projects are ineligible.
